notes.title: For those who want to play the game in fullscreen
notes.notes:
The game cannot be played in full screen mode. This is because it distorts the UI. We tried solving the issue, but having a fixed resolution provided the best game play experience. 

Yes, we did play test the game, but we are a very very small team. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: If you are still having problems with the navigation
notes.notes:
I am still getting complaints about the navigation. At this point there isn't a whole lot we could do to improve it. 

What we might do is just gut the Nav Mesh and do something completely different for future games. Clearly the system we used  isn't working. 

Thank you for the feedback. We're sorry to those who are frustrated with the game. Hopefully we can provide a better experience in the future.

notes.title: Vacant finally released on Steam!
notes.notes:
First and foremost, Vacant has been released on Steam! It is currently on sale over at the Steam page. Check it out and leave a positive review!

NEW FEATURES

Vacant is now out of Early Access. All of the digital portraits have been added, and the nav mesh has been improved. There is still a chance you will run into a glitch. There is only one person working on the game, so any help would be appreciated.
